notes.title: Human Fall Flat 2 - the sequel you've been waiting for!
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for joining us on the Human Fall Flat journey. Since 2016, you have helped make this game a very special community experience for our development team and millions around the world.
Now we are ready to reveal the next step for all of us Humans, 

[h3]HUMAN FALL FLAT 2![/h3]

[previewyoutube=Iw118oOrKzQ;full]https://youtu.be/Iw118oOrKzQ[/previewyoutube]

It’s the bigger, better, and clumsier sequel to your favorite puzzle-platforming action featuring brand new levels, customisable characters, and even wilder physics-based fun.

Whether you're playing solo or with your friends, we have many exciting adventures in store. Wishlist and Follow us here on Steam so you’ll fall upon every bit of Human Fall Flat news.

[h1]Wishlist now![/h1]
